name.taken.message: A digest called “{name}” already exists. Pick another name.

feed.required: Give the feed's address, or pick a connected WordPress site.
feed.site: Pick a connected WordPress site, or give a feed address instead.

feed.address.note: detail: why the address can't be used, in English from the feed reader

categories.none: Pick at least one category. With none, every post is left out and every issue is skipped.

schedule.invalid.note: detail: what to change in the schedule

prepare.range: Prepare 1 to 24 hours before the send time.
late.values: The late limit is 6, 24 or 48 hours.
audience.required: Pick who the issues go to: a list or a segment.
audience.unknown: One of the lists or segments doesn't exist any more. Pick the audience again.
sender.unknown: That sender doesn't exist. Pick another From.
start.latest: Include the latest 1 to 20 items in the first issue.

on.needsSend.message: Sending each issue automatically needs campaigns:send. You can turn it on in draft mode: each issue becomes a draft you send through Review & send.
on.needsSend.note: a member without campaigns:send tried to turn on a digest that sends automatically

on.needsFeed: The feed hasn't been read yet. Read it once before turning the digest on.
on.needsAudience: Pick an audience before turning the digest on.
on.needsTemplate: Design the email before turning the digest on: its template is empty.
delete.on: Pause the digest before deleting it: it is on.
issue.notOpen: That issue isn't waiting any more: it was sent or skipped.
issue.releaseNotHeld: Only a held issue can be released.

issue.releaseBlocked.message: Send Readiness still blocks the issue ({count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}). Fix it first, then release it.

issue.rebuildState: Only a prepared issue that hasn't started sending can be rebuilt.
issue.noTemplate: The digest has no template to build issues from. Design the email first.
issue.noItems: There are no new posts to build the next issue from.

feed.failed.note: detail: why the feed couldn't be read, in English

feed.noLink.message: {address} is a web page that links to no feed. Give the feed's own address.
